card.text: Saucer-shaped moon that keeps Saturn's Encke Gap open.

introduction.text: Pan is Saturn's innermost known moon. Mark Showalter found it in 1990 in Voyager 2 images taken nine years earlier.

normal.title: ISS mosaic
normal.summary: Photographs mapped onto the measured shape; shadows and unreliable samples are left out.

filter-color.title: Cassini false color
filter-color.summary: Measured filter bands in false color, not human-visible color. Photographed shadows remain.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height above or below a 14 km sphere from the Cassini shape; accuracy varies by region.
